articles.title: The "Next James Bond" Actors Who Never Played James Bond
articles.summary: While there have only been seven actors to have been officially cast as 007, there have been dozens the media has erroneously labeled as “the next James Bond.”
articles.body:
It's been five years since No Time to Die, Daniel Craig's final James Bond film, was released and we finally officially know for certain who his successor is for the role of 007: Robert Pattinson .

Even before Craig stepped down, the rumor mill was in overdrive speculating about who would succeed him in the role of 007. This has been a media tradition throughout the franchise’s long history ever since Sean Connery retired his license to kill. But while there have only been now seven actors to (officially) play 007 onscreen, there have been dozens that the media has erroneously labeled as being “the next James Bond.”

For the purposes of this feature not running longer than SPECTRE, we’re going to just narrow it down to those actors most often reported as “the next James Bond” in the Daniel Craig era, starting from the time Pierce Brosnan exited the franchise in 2002 until the present.

Here then are all the actors who had been pegged as the Next James Bond … and who never ended up playing Bond (well, not yet anyway).

The Next James Bonds Who Never Played 007

James Bond is the second major role that we know of that Hoult has lost out on to Robert Pattinson, the first being the title role in Matt Reeves' The Batman. Hoult wound up getting cast as Lex Luthor in James Gunn's Superman, although we'll have to see now if Hoult will stick around as Lex after Man of Tomorrow comes out in the wake of Gunn's exit from DC Studios.

The Fantastic Beasts, Masters of the Air, and One Night Only actor seemed like the front runner to star in James Bond 26 when word spread of the screen tests for director Denis Villeneuve. Turner also seemed like he had the edge given that his wife is pop star Dua Lipa, who could've also done the movie's theme song. But it wasn't meant to be.

The Slow Horses star's passionate fanbase campaigned hard for Lowden, as did his co-star Gary Oldman, but in the end Robert Pattinson prevailed.

O'Connor starred opposite Daniel Craig in the Knives Out sequel Wake Up, Dead Man, who told IGN he started the rumor about O'Connor being up for the Bond role just to annoy him while doing press. But O'Connor still ended up screen-testing for the role, ultimately losing out to Pattinson.

The Sinners and Ink actor's name was brought up in recent reports as being a contender for 007 but, as far as we know, he never screen-tested for the role.

The Frankenstein, Euphoria and Wuthering Heights star was widely seen as a leading and bankable contender for the role, but whether or not he ever seriously considered the role or was formally offered it remains unclear.

The Nosferatu, Kraven the Hunter and Werwulf actor had been the subject of Bond casting buzz going back to before EON Productions parted ways with the franchise. His name seemed to disappear from being in contention once the new producers and Amazon MGM Studios came aboard.

Was the Spider-Man star ever truly up for the role or was it all just rumor-mongering by the press? Holland always did seem a bit too young and too short for the role.

The Dark Tower and Thor actor’s name resurfaced recently as Daniel Craig’s successor, something the actor already called “a very old rumor” way back in 2011 ! "I would do it, but I don't want to be called the first black James Bond. Do you understand what I'm saying? Sean Connery wasn't the Scottish James Bond and Daniel Craig wasn't the blue-eyed James Bond. So if I played him, I don't want to be called the black James Bond,” Elba said in 2011. "If [then Bond distributor] Sony decided to call me and said hey, we wanted to do [James Bond], I'd definitely consider it." (Note: Sony is no longer the distributor of the Bond movies and it will be the producers’ not the distributor’s call on who plays 007.) Many fans certainly want Elba for the role, but they have also said the same thing about …

The Fury Road and Venom star’s name has come up many times through the years, most often in association with director Christopher Nolan, an avowed Bond fan who has made no secret of his desire to direct a Bond film. While Nolan and Hardy already made their own Bond-esque film with Inception, Hardy was linked with the role again as recently as July 2018. Hardy, for his part, has made cheeky comments about the rumors in interviews and on social media . Time will tell if Hardy ever takes on the secret agent.

The Loki actor has made no secret of his desire to play Bond. The rumors really heated up in 2016 when he reportedly met with EON Productions about the role . Of course, the producers could have just been meeting with Hiddleston as leverage against a then-reluctant to return Daniel Craig. In any case, Bond producer Barbara Broccoli reportedly thought Hiddleston wasn’t tough enough for the role, and Daniel Craig eventually signed on for Bond 25.

The Henry Cavill-James Bond rumor was actually legit at one point. The Superman star was the runner-up for the role back when Casino Royale was being cast but, then at only age 23, he lost out to Daniel Craig. Cavill, however, has made absolutely no secret about still wanting the role, reiterating his interest in it as recently as the Mission: Impossible - Fallout press tour, telling Yahoo! , “I would love to do it of course. I think Bond would be a really fun role. It’s British, it’s cool. I think that now that I have my Mission: Impossible badge we can do real stunts and really amp it up as well.”

Long before Idris Elba was the actor everyone seemed to believe was the inevitable choice as the next James Bond there was Clive Owen. The actor’s tuxedo-clad turn in the late ‘90s film Croupier kicked off years’ worth of rumor-mongering that he would succeed Pierce Brosnan as 007. Even now, at age 53, Owen still gets asked about the chances he’ll be the next James Bond despite having said he was never even offered the role to begin with.

The Wolverine actor was rumored for the role quite a bit during the 2000s, but last year he admitted to Variety that he’d actually turned down the part years earlier: “I was about to do X-Men 2 and a call came from my agent asking if I’d be interested in Bond. I just felt at the time that the scripts had become so unbelievable and crazy, and I felt like they needed to become grittier and real. And the response was: ‘Oh, you don’t get a say. You just have to sign on.’ I was also worried that between Bond and X-Men, I’d never have time to do different things.” The timing of Jackman’s approach would have coincided with the release of Pierce Brosnan’s final Bond film, Die Another Day, in 2002.

The Billions actor has been a reported “next James Bond” since his days on Homeland, with bookies reportedly naming him the odds-on favorite for the role back in 2015. When asked about the rumors in 2017, Lewis quipped, “By the time they make a decision [on Bond] I’ll be dead. … So no one need worry any more.”

While the X-Men and Prometheus actor had long been rumored as Daniel Craig’s successor, he essentially ruled himself out of the running in a 2016 interview : “No, I think the franchise needs something new." Fassbender praised Craig for having done “a cracking job” with the role.

The Beauty and the Beast star was first linked with the role back during his Downton Abbey days, but it was his lean, mean, butt-kicking turn in The Guest that led the press to proclaim him “the next James Bond.” But then Daniel Craig signed back on for one more go as 007 …

The Aussie actor, who parlayed his acclaimed turn in the true crime flick Chopper into lead roles in Hulk and Troy, was a reported frontrunner to succeed Pierce Brosnan after Die Another Day. Bana repeatedly denied the rumors back in 2004, and his co-star in Munich, Daniel Craig, won the role in the 2006 reboot Casino Royale.

The Star Wars and Trainspotting actor reportedly turned down the role of 007 back when Casino Royale was gearing up, but his views on the opportunity have evolved since then. "I think it would be quite cool to play James Bond," McGregor told The Hollywood Reporter in 2015. "At this stage in my career (being typecast) is not really an issue anymore. Early on, when you start off you don't want your horizons to be narrow, but I think people know I have some kind of width in my work, so I'm really not worried about that anymore."

The late Doctor Doom and Nip/Tuck actor said back in 2004 that he’d been “in talks” for the role but later reportedly passed on the role due to his TV commitments.

Before he starred in the highest-grossing movie of all time, Avatar, Worthington was one of the reported finalists who did costumed screen tests for Casino Royale along with Daniel Craig and Henry Cavill.

Bale’s name first surfaced in 2002 as a possible replacement for Pierce Brosnan, with the actor reportedly saying at a convention that he’d be open to playing the role. In 2014, however, Bale shot down old reports that he was offered the role before Daniel Craig.

The Croatian native and ER actor screen-tested back in 2005 for Casino Royale and was reportedly a favorite of director Martin Campbell’s. The role went to Daniel Craig, of course.

Long before playing Sandor “The Hound” Clegane on Game of Thrones, the Scottish actor reportedly screen-tested for the role of Bond back in 2005 for Casino Royale.

The Fantastic Four and Turn actor made headlines as a Bond contender in 2016 when he reportedly met with producer Barbara Broccoli about the role. Broccoli and Bell were making the movie Film Stars Don't Die in Liverpool at the time, and the producer was said to have been a fan of Bell’s for sometime.

Dan Stevens isn’t the only Beauty and the Beast star who’s been linked as a frontrunner for the role. Luke Evans was reportedly on the shortlist to replace Daniel Craig in 2016 before the latter signed on for one last film.

The Poldark star reportedly had preliminary meetings with Bond producers back in 2016. After Daniel Craig ended up agreeing to return for Bond 25, Turner informed the British press in 2018, “There’s someone else playing the role at the moment, but when it’s free I’ll have a look at it.”

The McMafia and Happy Valley actor was reportedly eyed for the role back in 2016 before Craig signed on for Bond 25. Norton told the press in July 2018, “I would love to play a Bond villain. I love Daniel Craig and I’d love him to do more films. He’s brought a whole other angle to the character — and long may that continue. But people love to speculate.”

The star of Hawaii 5-0 and Man-Thing (yes, there was a TV movie based on the Marvel comic) told the press he did a full costume screen test for Casino Royale but that he was probably too young for the role at the time.

The 300 star has fielded countless questions through the years about possibly playing James Bond, ultimately telling the press in 2009 that he wasn’t interested in the part: “I enjoy doing an array of films. If I was to play Bond, that would quickly stop. How likely would I be accepted doing those roles after having played Bond?" Butler later accepted roles in Geostorm and Gods of Egypt.

The Sherlock Holmes and future Captain Marvel actor was a much talked about contender back in the early 2000s before Daniel Craig took on the role in Casino Royale. "To be really honest, I don`t know if it`s for me," Law said of the role in 2003.

The Mission: Impossible 2 actor confirmed in a 2004 interview that years of Bond rumors were true. Scott said he was approached for the role back when it looked like Pierce Brosnan was going to bail on the franchise but then he decided to do one last Bond film with Die Another Day.

The Following and Rome actor was an oft-reported Bond contender years ago, first for GoldenEye and later Casino Royale. Purefoy said in a 2006 interview that he blew his audition for Casino Royale, believing the producers probably saw him as “Brosnan Lite”.

So who’s your favorite “next James Bond” contender? Let us know in the comments. And for more on actors who almost played iconic genre roles, check out these 15 Actors Who Almost Played Avengers and Actors Who Almost Played Batman .

Disney Dreamlight Valley's next update, The Keepsake Sea , will go live on Nov. 18. It's always exciting when Disney Dreamlight Valley gets a new update with all sorts of resources and characters, but this update is extra unique: It takes the game underwater and into the world of mermaids.

The new content includes three new biomes, three companions, and a pirate ship. You'll meet Dory from Finding Nemo , as well as others.

Let's dive into the patch notes to go deeper into the update.

Your journey to the Keepsake Sea begins at Dazzle Beach, where you'll discover a mysterious statue that contains a message from an old friend that is lost and stranded. To find them, you'll need to reach a faraway kingdom across the sea...

You’ll begin your underwater adventures by unlocking your Merfolk form, with new customization options including ears, fins, arms, torsos, tail patterns, and plenty of color options.

While in Merfolk form, you can still interact with Villagers and the environment, opening up new Photo Mode and DreamSnaps possibilities.

As a Merfolk, you’ll also be able to swim across the surface of water throughout the Valley and previous expansions areas, diving into ripples to collect fish instantly!

On your adventure you'll travel to three brand new island Biomes with unique environments, where you'll meet a slew of new venturing Disney and Pixar characters, as well as the 4 Guardians that watch over The Keepsake Sea, whom you’ll need to awaken from their slumber before you can prove you have a childlike spirit! The first island you'll encounter is Shipwreck Shores, a colorful take on a typical pirate bay, where you’ll meet Milo Thatch from Disney’s Atlantis: The Lost Empire and Captain Jack Sparrow from Disney’s Pirates of the Caribbean! After Shipwreck Shores, you'll venture to Candy Cove, the second Biome, a quaint fantasy world made up of frosty desserts. Here you'll meet Megara from Disney’s Hercules and Captain Hook from Disney’s Peter Pan! Oh, and we can’t forget there's also a magical narwal! Lastly, you'll explore the Kingdom of Oublié, a special place that extends above and below the sea, made up of coral seashell motifs. In this forgotten kingdom you'll meet Wendy from Disney’s Peter Pan.

articles.title: There Really Is No Escape From The Duolingo Owl, Who Will Soon Join Pokémon Go
articles.summary: Not content with plaguing your phone's lock screen, Duo the Duolingo owl is next set to appear in Pokémon Go.
articles.body:
Not content with plaguing your phone's lock screen, Duo the Duolingo owl is next set to appear in Pokémon Go .

A crossover between the two hugely-popular smartphone apps has been announced, unlocking bonuses for players in both experiences. (Sadly, no, you won't be able to trap Duo in a Pokéball forever.)

The fun begins on November 17, when a time-limited event begins in Duolingo that requires you to complete at least one language lesson on seven separate days. This will then unlock a series of Pokémon-themed outfits for your Duolingo profile.

Completing all of that will also grant a promo code for Pokémon Go, unlocking timed research that awards Pokémon such as Pikachu and regional exclusive Chatot with a unique Duolingo background. It's rather cute — even if it does feature more of Duo the owl, too.

Pokemon Go Snapshot: Instructions and Photobombs

Why is all of this happening? While Pokémon Go has featured sponsored cosmetic items in the past, the game rarely offers this level of collaboration, and particularly not with another smartphone app. Still, earlier this year, the game also partnered with LEGO to offer similar bonus gameplay, centered around LEGO stores.

More prescient, perhaps, is the rollout of a new feature within Pokémon Go that will allow players to view the name of their creatures in multiple languages for the first time. While Pikachu is known as Pikachu the world over, other species have some very different names on foreign shores. (Snorlax is "Relaxo" in German, for example.)

And finally, in other Pokémon Go collaboration news, the creature catching app will soon feature a crossover with Crocs, the shoe brand that already offers a range of Pokémon clogs. All players can now unlock a virtual pair of Pikachu shoes by entering the promo code "POKEMONGOxCROCSxELECTRIFYING". Owners of the real-life Gengar and Jigglypuff shoes, meanwhile, will get codes for similar virtual versions of their own footwear.

articles.title: New Zealand tricks and annual leave - the lengths fans are going to for GTA 6
articles.summary: Sensor Tower estimates the game has already made $1.18bn from pre-orders across PlayStation and Xbox
articles.body:
After 13 years of waiting, some GTA 6 fans are taking extra steps to play the game - from booking time off work, buying a console to play it on or even pretending they're halfway around the world to get early access.

Market intelligence firm Sensor Tower estimates GTA 6 has already generated $1.18bn (£894m) from 12 million pre-orders - although Rockstar has not confirmed this.

Despite the option to preload the 212GB game, Jennifer Holmes, chief executive of the London Internet Exchange, said several UK internet providers including BT and Virgin Media had "increased capacity in anticipation of higher demand" ahead of launch.

But for some fans, simply having the game ready to play is not enough.

GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game

Gamers have long been known to book time off work for major releases.

When Red Dead Redemption 2 launched in October 2018, social media users were sharing plans to take the day off, with one analytics firm reportedly finding more people talking about calling in sick for it than any other game that year.

Similar conversations took place ahead of Cyberpunk 2077's release in December 2020, with fans discussing taking several days off to play.

GTA 6 is no exception, but it appears to characteristically be taking things to a whole new level.

For the game's launch day, HR software company BrightHR looked at absence data from more than 1.2 million employees from 70,000 businesses across the UK.

It found GTA was mentioned in 4.6% of time-off requests by employees. Throughout November and December, it said an estimated 83,000 days had been booked off for the game.

According to the HR firm, one person put "new GTA is coming out! I will be spending a week on the sofa in my pants!" as the reason for their leave request, while another said: "play the new GTA - I've waited a billion years".

A third said in their request: "GTA Release - I'll put my notice in if this is denied."

The company added it had no way of tracking if the requests had actually been approved by employers.

Some places have even decided to lean into the trend by offering incentives around the game – including the US Army's 3rd Infantry Division based at Fort Stewart, Georgia.

It gave some active-duty soldiers a four-day pass to play the game when it is released in November, as long as they sign a reenlistment contract for a minimum of two years between 1 August and 12 November.

"The idea was to have a unique incentives programme that connects to what soldiers are interested in," public affairs officer for the division, Lieutenant Colonel Angel Tomko confirmed to the BBC in August.

"There are 130 soldiers eligible within the battalion, and 20 have selected this incentive as part of their reenlistment," she said at the time.

Aside from taking time off, some gamers have also been discussing a technical loophole which could give them valuable extra hours of play before it officially unlocks in their country.

Because GTA 6 will release at midnight local time in all regions, New Zealand will become one of the first places where it is available, due to it reaching midnight earliest because of its position near the international date line.

This has led to some investigating ways to "trick" their consoles into thinking they're based in the island country when they are in fact thousands of miles away.

According to Google Trends, searches for the "GTA 6 New Zealand trick" have surged by more than 5,000% in the UK over the past month.

Games journalist Vic Hood said many gamers would be looking to play earlier to "get in on the action as soon as possible", as well as to prevent spoilers.

"As New Zealand is 13 hours ahead of the UK, that's 13 hours of gameplay that has time to spread across the internet and potentially spoil some key story beats and in-game surprises," she said.

"Took an extra day of paid time off when I found this out," one fan posted on Reddit on the trick.

It also means gamers would be playing the game at the much nicer time of 11:00 GMT, rather than having to stay up all night.

But another Xbox user shared caution on Reddit, noting that while the loophole had been exploited for many years for other game releases, GTA 6 "might be the game where Microsoft finally does something about this 'exploit'" - which could include banning players.

GTA 6's developers Rockstar and publishers Take Two Interactive have not commented on the loophole, and neither has Sony nor Microsoft.

Louise Wooldridge from analyst firm Ampere Analysis said both Microsoft and Sony had "rules governing regional accounts and purchases" for the Xbox and PlayStation, adding that Sony's were "slightly more restrictive".

Players who choose to use the workaround could therefore risk breaching those terms and conditions and potentially face restrictions on their accounts or lose access to their digital games.

Some gamers will have to wait even longer than their console-playing counterparts to get their hands on GTA 6, as the game will not be available on PC at launch, similar to previous GTA releases.

"Spare a thought for the PC users who will have to live vicariously through others' YouTube videos and Twitch streams," gamer Stephen Finn told the BBC.

A PS5 now costs from £520, while the more powerful PS5 Pro is nearly £790.

Despite the hefty price tag, for some the temptation to join the community in playing what many have called the biggest game launch of the year, if not decade, has been too great.

Reddit posts and videos, such as one by US YouTuber isoish , show fans buying consoles specifically to play the game.

"So, the only game I'm going to have on here is GTA," the content creator said in the video.

After more than a decade of waiting, it seems some fans are determined not to waste a single minute of GTA 6's release - no matter what the cost or extra effort.

articles.title: Assault Ship of the East (Mysterious Ship) Blueprint Locations - Crimson Desert Guide - IGN
articles.summary: The Assault Ship of the East is one of four legendary ships in Crimson Desert's Charting the Unknown DLC. Unlike the Phantom Ship, this vessel requires
articles.body:
The Assault Ship of the East is one of four legendary ships in Crimson Desert 's Charting the Unknown DLC. Unlike the Phantom Ship , this vessel requires you to collect four Mysterious Ship Blueprints across the Great Ocean of Pywel. This page details the locations of all four Mysterious Ship Blueprints and explains how to construct the Assault Ship of the East.

There are four Mysterious Ship Blueprints to collect before you can craft the Assault Ship of the East. One is on the mainland, one is on an island, and two are sunken beneath the sea.

Mysterious Ship Blueprint Part 1 Location

The first Mysterious Ship Blueprint is located in a shipwreck at the bottom of the Great Rocky Reef near the Sea of Silence on the eastern border of the map.

The ship graveyard is approximately 130 meters beneath the surface. There are giant underwater tornadoes surrounding the wreckage, so they're hard to miss.

On the eastern side of the ship graveyard (closer to the whirlpools), you'll find a wrecked ship with some curved wooden parts sticking out of the ground. Collect the Unidentified Box on the ground inside to get Mysterious Ship Blueprint Part 1.

Mysterious Ship Blueprint Part 2 Location

The second Mysterious Ship Blueprint is found in the same ship graveyard as the first, at the bottom of the Great Rocky Reef.

This blueprint isn't too far from the first. Across from the ship containing the first Unidentified Box, there's another wreck. All that's left is the basic wooden frame. The blueprint is contained in an Unidentified Box inside that wreck.

Mysterious Ship Blueprint Part 3 Location

The third Mysterious Ship Blueprint is located at the Bravgork Shipyard in Gorthak, near Regent's Rise.

There's a giant wooden ship being constructed at the shipyard, and the blueprint is inside. Just enter the door at the back behind the stairs and collect the Unidentified Box on the wooden shelf.

Mysterious Ship Blueprint Part 4 Location

The fourth Mysterious Ship Blueprint is located on the eastern coast of Estra Island.

You'll find it at an abandoned camp on the beach. Look for a small shipwreck by a tent with a bunch of cannonballs. The blueprint is in an Unidentified Box on the table.

How to Craft the Assault Ship of the East

Once you've collected all four blueprint parts, you need to combine them in your inventory to unlock the Assault Ship of the East. To do so, open your inventory, find the blueprint parts in your key items, then hold the "Use" button to restore them into a complete schematic.

Afterward, read the completed blueprint to acquire knowledge of the ship. You can then start building it via a dispatch mission at Port Delesyia.

The mission will take 100 in-game hours to complete, but afterward, your new vessel will be waiting for you at port!

articles.body:
Gossip Quests are a special scavenger hunt feature in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake that are exclusive to the ZELDA NOTES App available through your Nintendo Switch mobile app connectivity. With a linked Nintendo Account, you can connect to ZELDA NOTES to view several features, including the Gossip Quest, which features a fun activity to hunt down rumors with small images hinting at various places all over Hyrule.

Finding these locations will award you points in the ZELDA NOTES app, which you can redeem for special ocarina themes.

To catalog these on the app, you must first make sure the app is connected to the game (indicated by a green switch icon in the top corner). Once you've located the site of a Rumor, you can either select "Found!" when you've approached the Gossip Quest Target, or interact with the Gossip Stone itself in a specific way, and you'll be awarded points for a successful hunt. There are 100 Gossip Quest Rumors in all, and the locations of each can be found in this page.

Rumor: "It is said that there's a precious, priceless drawing..."

Location - Kokiri Forest: House of the Twins - In the starting area of the game, enter the house in the far southeast corner of the village near the tunnel to the Great Deku Tree, and look for girl who is drawing several different colored Rupees.

Rumor: "It is said that there's a brave warrior scarecrow..."

Location - Kokiri Forest: Kokiri Shop - In the starting area of the game, head to the shop in the northeast corner of the village across the small stream. Inside, you can find a scarecrow for target practice on the right side of the shop.

Rumor: "It is said that one nestling close to the forest's storyteller joyfully wobbles from side to side..."

Location - Kokiri Forest: Great Deku Tree - In the starting area of the game, once you have obtained a sword and shield, you can find this rumor spot in the form of a Gossip Stone by the Geat Deku Tree itself -- the one closest to the tree on the left. To solve this quest, you'll need to strike the Gossip Stone with your sword.

Rumor: "It is said that one loitering in the sunlight filtering through the large trees joyfully wobbles from side to side...

Location - Kokiri Forest: Great Deku Tree - In the starting area of the game, once you have obtained a sword and shield, you can find this rumor spot in the form of a Gossip Stone by the Geat Deku Tree itself -- the one farthest to the tree on the left. To solve this quest, you'll need to strike the Gossip Stone with your sword.

Rumor: It is said that moss sometimes makes the best bench..."

Location - Kokiri Forest: Mido's House - In the starting area of the game, you can find the location of this rumor in the home on the far northwest side of the village in Mido's House. Between two chests is a bench with moss on it.

Rumor: "It is said that the one guarding children from the grass joyfully bounces up and down..."

Location - Kokiri Forest: Lost Woods Entrance - In the starting area of the game, you can find this rumor in the form of a Gossip Stone on the far northern side of the village, just to the west of the entrance to the Lost Woods along a high pathway. To solve this quest, you'll need to strike the Gossip Stone with your sword.

Rumor: "It is said that a new resident has moved into Kokiri Forest..."

Location - Kokiri Forest: Link's House (Adult Era) - Once you have become an adult, you'll need to rescue Epona and restore Lon Lon Ranch to its former glory. You can then take on Malon's obstacle course, and if you complete the course under the time limit, she'll reward you with a cow that's delivered to Link's home in Kokiri Forest, which will fulfill the rumor location!

Rumor: "It is said that a stage deep in the woods awaits a challenger..."

Location - Lost Woods: From the entrance to the Lost Woods, take the first tunnel to the right. This leads to an overlook with a large clearing down below and a tree trunk split into two platforms where Skull Children want to play a minigame, and the site of the rumor.

Rumor: "It is said that there is a secluded forest, far from civilization, where the playful sound of a flute echoes..."

Location - Lost Woods: From the entrance to the Lost Woods, take the first tunnel to the left. This leads to a forest clearing with a high tree trunk on which a Skull Kid plays the flute, and is the site of the rumor's location.

Rumor: "It is said that the one beckoning the lost joyfully bounces up and down..."

Location - Lost Woods: From the entrance to the Lost Woods, take the first tunnel to the left, past a forest clearing and into the next tunnel, which overlooks the bridge to Hyrule Field. On the far side of this ravine you can find the quest location, taking the form of a Gossip Stone, which you must strike with your weapon to complete.

Rumor: "It is said that the one who guides travelers to the recesses of a deep forest joyfully spins and stretches..."

Location - Sacred Grove: Once in the Sacred Grove past the Lost Woods, head to the end of the maze and then turn around before the long stairs to find a ladder up to the top of the ruins. Jump back across south to find the rumor location in the form of a Gossip Stone, and use Din's FIre to make it spin and stretch.

Rumor: "It is said that within the Sacred Grove, there is a life that is drawing to a close..."

Location - Sacred Grove: Once in the Sacred Grove past the Lost Woods, head to the end of the maze and then turn around before the long stairs to find a ladder up to the top of the ruins. Jump back across south and look along the east side for a broken tree along the edge of the platforms.

Rumor: "It is said that one who welcomes guests in the deep forest joyfully spins and stretches..."

Location - Sacred Grove: Once in the Sacred Grove past the Lost Woods, head to the end of the maze and then turn around before the long stairs to find a ladder up to the top of the ruins. Jump back across south and look along the west side to find the rumor location in the form of a Gossip Stone, and use Din's FIre to make it spin and stretch.

Rumor: "It is said that the one watching over the sanctuary joyfully jumps to the skies..."

Location - Sacred Grove: At the far end of the Sacred Grove where Saria plays her ocarina in front of the Forest Temple entrance, you can find this rumor location in the form of a Gossip Stone, and you can plant a bomb to make it launch into the air.

Rumor: "It is said that the one who awaits visitors in the sanctuary that light cannot reach joyfully spins and stretches..."

Location - Sacred Grove: Once you have learned the Song of Time by obtaining the Ocarina of Time, return to the entrance to the Forest Temple where Saria plays her ocarina, and you can find a Hidden Hole in the corner you can open with a bomb. Inside, play the Song of Time to remove the blue blocks to reveal the rumor's location in the form of a Gossip Stone that you can light with Din's Fire to make spin and stretch.

articles.title: Legendary Ships - Crimson Desert Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Legendary Ships are the strongest vessels you can captain in Crimson Desert's Charting the Unknown DLC. These rare ships require you to track down several
articles.body:
Legendary Ships are the strongest vessels you can captain in Crimson Desert 's Charting the Unknown DLC. These rare ships require you to track down several blueprints scattered across the Great Ocean of Pywel. There's also an insanely high cost for each one, so you may need to grind for camp funds in order to craft them. These are all the legendary ships we've found in Crimson Desert so far.

There are four legendary ships in Crimson Desert Charting the Unknown. Use the links below to jump to our dedicated guides for each, or scroll down the page for more details.

The Phantom Ship blueprint is found in a buried treasure chest on Illya Island near the southern edge of the map. You'll find it on the southwestern side of the island.

The chest is buried right next to the Rocky Hill Ocean Ruins of Illya Island puzzle with the rotating mural of a whale. Head there (or fast travel to the Abyss Cresset if you've already solved the puzzle), and then look to the north.

Ignore the footpath along the cliff's edge. Instead, drop down to the area below the path with the stone mounds.

You'll find the treasure chest buried next to some stacked cairn stones and red plants. Use a shovel to remove the surrounding dirt and dig it up.

Once you've found and read the Phantom Ship blueprint, you still need to craft the vessel before you can set sail. It's one of the most expensive items in the game, requiring the following materials:

Obsidian can be found on the southern islands of Pywel's ocean, particularly Estra Island, Bergel Island, and Satyros Island. Look out for dark ore nodes among the gray cliffs.

Giant Jellyfish Skin can be harvested from Giant Jellyfish, which spawn rarely in the Great Coral Reef region. You can tell them apart from other jellyfish by their bright pink color (and large size). Hunt for these at night to spot them more easily!

Finally, Natural Pearls are the hardest ingredients to get. They can very rarely be found in clams at the deepest parts of the ocean, but you can also obtain them from a Greymane dispatch mission on Illya Island. Pioneer the island, then repeat the dispatch mission to stock up.

Once you have the necessary materials, deposit them into your private storage chest in Kliff's tent at the Greymane camp. Then, select any port on the map and you'll be able to start a dispatch mission to construct the Phantom Ship!

To get the Drunken Catfish blueprint, you have to defeat the Drunken Catfish pirates. They patrol the western coastal waters of Samora Island.

Crimson Desert's pirate ships don't stick in one place for too long, so you may have to sail around the island's coast before you encounter them. Keep an eye out for the Drunken Catfish's signature red and black sails.

You'll need a sizable crew to take down the Drunken Catfish crew, so make sure you've at least got a full set of gunners on deck. If you're having a hard time, try coming back with another legendary ship like the Phantom Ship or Assault Ship of the East.

Once the Drunken Catfish has been defeated, you'll automatically receive the blueprint as a reward. Find it in your inventory and read it to unlock the crafting recipe.

Once you've read the blueprint for the Drunken Catfish, you can construct it at the port in Vellua. It requires the following crafting materials:

Assault Ship of the East Blueprint Locations

There are four Mysterious Ship Blueprints to collect before you can craft the Assault Ship of the East. One is on the mainland, one is on an island, and two are sunken beneath the sea.

Mysterious Ship Blueprint Part 1 Location

The first Mysterious Ship Blueprint is located in a shipwreck at the bottom of the Great Rocky Reef near the Sea of Silence on the eastern border of the map.

The ship graveyard is approximately 130 meters beneath the surface. There are giant underwater tornadoes surrounding the wreckage, so they're hard to miss.

On the eastern side of the ship graveyard (closer to the whirlpools), you'll find a wrecked ship with some curved wooden parts sticking out of the ground. Collect the Unidentified Box on the ground inside to get Mysterious Ship Blueprint Part 1.

Mysterious Ship Blueprint Part 2 Location

The second Mysterious Ship Blueprint is found in the same ship graveyard as the first, at the bottom of the Great Rocky Reef.

This blueprint isn't too far from the first. Across from the ship containing the first Unidentified Box, there's another wreck. All that's left is the basic wooden frame. The blueprint is contained in an Unidentified Box inside that wreck.

Mysterious Ship Blueprint Part 3 Location

The third Mysterious Ship Blueprint is located at the Bravgork Shipyard in Gorthak, near Regent's Rise.

There's a giant wooden ship being constructed at the shipyard, and the blueprint is inside. Just enter the door at the back behind the stairs and collect the Unidentified Box on the wooden shelf.

Mysterious Ship Blueprint Part 4 Location

The fourth Mysterious Ship Blueprint is located on the eastern coast of Estra Island.

You'll find it at an abandoned camp on the beach. Look for a small shipwreck by a tent with a bunch of cannonballs. The blueprint is in an Unidentified Box on the table.

How to Craft the Assault Ship of the East

Once you've collected all four blueprint parts, you need to combine them in your inventory to unlock the Assault Ship of the East. To do so, open your inventory, find the blueprint parts in your key items, then hold the "Use" button to restore them into a complete schematic.

Afterward, read the completed blueprint to acquire knowledge of the ship. You can then start building it via a dispatch mission at Port Delesyia.

The mission will take 100 in-game hours to complete, but afterward, your new vessel will be waiting for you at port!

articles.body:
There are four Blackstone Fragments in Mountain of Imprisonment.

Mountain of Imprisonment Blackstone Fragment 1

From the first bell, The Lady’s Path , follow the right trail, which will lead you to a small camp with enemies. Defeat them, and the first boss, Iron Butcher , will appear. Defeat him, and you’ll see a purple chest on a wall, next to a staircase.

Mountain of Imprisonment Blackstone Fragment 2

In Hanging Cage Cavern , follow the main path (stick to the left) until you go past a locked door and enter a small arena with multiple enemies. You’ll have to kill them all for the Blackstone. Here you’ll also find an NPC trapped in a cage .

articles.body:
There are six Memory Flowers in Mountain of Imprisonment.

Mountain of Imprisonment Memory Flower 1

After defeating the first boss, Iron Butcher, in the Iron Butcher’s Camp (the second area in the region), you’ll see a purple chest on a wall. Climb the ladder on the left to it, and wallrun to reach the flower on a separate platform.

This is Memory Flower on Huangxing II - The Last Pillar .

Mountain of Imprisonment Memory Flower 2

On the right side of the Iron Butcher’s Camp, you’ll notice a path on higher ground that goes around some destroyed buildings . Follow that path until you reach a wall with marks, indicating that you can slide down.

Jump into it, but don’t wait to reach the ground floor — you need to jump backwards and reach the floor in the middle. You’ll find the petal here.

This is Memory Flower on Huangxing II - Defend, Defend, Defend .
